{"method":"POST","endpoint":"/v1/sql/query","payload":"{\"query\":\"WITH ranked AS (SELECT client_id, balance_after, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY tx_date DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM trust_transactions WHERE DATE(tx_date) <= DATE('2026-09-10')), truth AS (SELECT CAST(client_id AS TEXT) AS client_key, balance_after AS true_balance FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.trust_balance AS stored_balance_before, COALESCE(t.true_balance, 0) AS true_balance, COALESCE(t.true_balance, 0) - c.trust_balance AS discrepancy_cents FROM clients c LEFT JOIN truth t ON t.client_key = CAST(c.id AS TEXT) WHERE (t.client_key IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(c.trust_balance, 0) <> 0) AND COALESCE(c.trust_balance, 0) <> COALESCE(t.true_balance, 0) ORDER BY c.id\"}","as_user":"verifier","metadata":{"purpose":"Identify exactly which reconciled client balances require correction as of the episode date, using policy ordering"}}

Run the firm's monthly three-way trust reconciliation, per firm policy TRUST-REC-01 (in firm_policies), batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta), as of the episode date.
